_note: FIRST baseline. 082-structural-group-detection T047 / FR-022 (b) — the inbound PARSE path on FIX 4.2. Release build, --benchmark_min_time=0.5s, 4 runs. Measured spread is 2-12%, so evaluate any future ±5% budget against `measured_release_ns_runs`, not against a single run.
_what_changed_on_this_path: table_view::is_group_tag() is the parse-path group pre-filter (table_view.hpp:737-741): it word-indexes group_bits_ and returns false when `w >= group_bits_.size()`. Pre-082 that vector was EMPTY on FIX 4.0/4.1/4.2 (their <group> count fields are typed legacy XML INT and detection keyed on the datatype), so every tag took the size-check short-circuit and the parser did NO group work. Post-082 it holds 7 words for FIX 4.2 (max registered no_tag 428 -> (428>>6)+1), so the same call loads a word and tests a bit, and a set bit descends into real group-context resolution (D-12).
_anti_vacuity: Every group-bearing row ASSERTS registration (`group_first_field(tag) != 0`) and a non-empty group walk (`group_slices(tag)` non-empty, reported as the `group_entries` counter) BEFORE the timed loop, via SkipWithError. A bench whose group silently failed to register would time a FLAT parse and report a perfectly plausible number — indistinguishable from success, and exactly the silent-success class this feature removes. The counters below are the evidence those gates fired: group_entries=2 (top-level) and =1 (nested).

benchmarks.name: BM_Fix42Parse_NoGroup
benchmarks.role: COMMON-PATH REGRESSION GUARD — the only row on this profile with a real pre-082 counterpart. Carries no group tag, so it still resolves to 'not a group', but now by loading a word and testing a bit instead of failing a size check. Every FIX 4.0/4.1/4.2 session pays this whether or not its traffic carries groups, so it must stay flat.
benchmarks.verdict: 176 ns median. No pre-082 number was captured for this specific profile (it did not exist), so this row establishes the baseline that FUTURE changes are measured against.

benchmarks.name: BM_Fix42Parse_TopLevelGroup
benchmarks._why_no_before: Pre-082, tag 268 was treated as a plain scalar on FIX 4.2 and the frame parsed FLAT. A 'before' figure would time a different operation, not a faster one — so comparing them would manufacture a regression or an improvement out of a change in what is being computed. Recorded as new, the same disposition 083's DivergentContext row took.
benchmarks.verdict: NEW ROW — +104 ns over the group-free path is the cost of real group-context resolution on a 2-entry group, measured in-session.

benchmarks.name: BM_Fix42Parse_NestedGroup
benchmarks.fixture: 35=i MassQuote, NoQuoteSets(296) -> NoQuoteEntries(295); mirrors the T044/T045 exemplar body incl. UnderlyingSymbol(311)
benchmarks.verdict: NEW ROW — the two-level shape US4's exemplar writes. +128 ns over the group-free path.

_cross_session_warning: Do NOT compare these figures against numbers taken in a different session. T048 established that this machine's two measurement sessions differ by 22-42% on identical work: `vt11`, which 082 provably does not touch, moved -35%. Only in-session comparisons between the rows above are load-bearing.
